Subject: Locking in technical deep dive — confirming availability

Hi Alex — great to connect on the discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: technical deep dive focused on inference latency targets, private deployment options (VPC), and expected throughput for your batch workload.
- Outcomes we want: architecture overview, integration checklist, and an initial sizing/recommendation for Dedicated vs Private.

Suggested 60–75 minute slots (all PST):
1) Tue Nov 11 — 10:00–11:15am PST
2) Tue Nov 11 — 2:00–3:15pm PST
3) Wed Nov 12 — 9:00–10:15am PST

Please confirm which option works and who from your engineering org will join (names + emails). If none of the times fit, tell me two windows that do and we’ll narrow to a single committed slot. I’ve attached a proposed agenda and a short solution brief to help structure the session.

Attachments: proposed-agenda.docx, solution-brief.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold the 10:00 slot tentatively until I hear back (no more than 24 hours).

—
